staticFrame.alt: An illustrated teal theatre with its curtains drawn back. Eight numbered pieces of scenery hang above the stage and an answer form carries three citation marks.

scenes.label: 01 / The theatre of an answer
scenes.heading:
Not every question
gets an answer.
scenes.lead: Sometimes, withholding one is the ending.
scenes.narration: Eight sources can arrive. An answer still has to earn its place on the stage. Scroll to follow two recorded queries to two different endings.

scenes.label: 02 / Before the answer
scenes.heading:
A stage.
A finite world.
scenes.lead: This is a bounded collection of drug guidance.
scenes.narration: MedRAG retrieves from that collection. This theatre is an editorial world; it is not a clinical interface, and it gives no medical advice.

scenes.label: 03 / Recorded query 1
scenes.heading:
Eight pieces
arrive.
scenes.narration: The evaluation records eight retrieved chunks. Their positions here are composed for the story, not similarity scores or embedding coordinates.

scenes.label: 04 / What travels with it
scenes.heading:
Three citations
remain attached.
scenes.lead: The answer does not travel alone.
scenes.narration: Query 1 was not refused. Three chunks were cited. The evaluation preserves these counts, but not the answer wording or identities of the chunks.

scenes.label: 05 / Try the contrast
scenes.heading:
Same retrieval.
Different ending.
scenes.lead: Switch between the two recorded queries.
scenes.narration: Watch the stage change between an answer with citations and a refusal. These are two existing evaluation records, not new model calls.

scenes.label: 06 / Recorded query 7
scenes.heading:
Again,
eight.
scenes.lead: An empty answer does not mean an empty retrieval.
scenes.narration: The second query also retrieved eight chunks. Finding material did not guarantee that an answer followed.

scenes.label: 07 / The empty stage
scenes.heading:
The most important
part is missing.
scenes.narration: The scenery moves to the wings. We keep the absence visible. The metadata records the refusal; it does not tell us its causal reason.

scenes.label: 08 / The result in full
scenes.heading:
Restraint belongs
in the result.
scenes.lead: Four refusals in twenty recorded queries.
scenes.narration: This is the final recorded RAGAS evaluation from 3 February 2026, using vector-only retrieval. It is an evaluation record, not evidence of clinical safety.

audio.explanation: This world is a silent illustrated evaluation story. It has no audio asset and makes no audio request.
